title: Sprint 13 Planning
raw_text:
Sarah: Welcome to Sprint 13 planning. First topic: we need to decide on the database for the new analytics module. I think MongoDB is the right choice for the analytics data. It handles unstructured data better.

Karim: Wait, we just migrated everything to PostgreSQL last sprint. Are we adding a second database now?

Sarah: Yes. The analytics data is different. It is schema-less and changes frequently. MongoDB is better for that use case. PostgreSQL stays for the core application data.

Lina: The dashboard requirements document is ready. I shared it on Confluence yesterday. The dashboard needs real-time filtering and we need it done by April 4.

Sarah: April 4 is tight. Karim, can you handle the backend API for the dashboard?

Karim: I can start, but if I also have to set up MongoDB, I cannot do both by April 4.

Sarah: Omar, can you handle the MongoDB setup?

Omar: I can set up the cluster, but someone needs to define the collections and indexes.

Sarah: We will figure out the ownership for the schema design later. Let us move on.

Youssef: For the frontend, I need the API contracts from Karim by March 28.

Karim: I will have them ready by March 28.

Sarah: Good. Next meeting is March 31.
